answer.value: The card links to a Hugging Face collection of Gemma 4 models, a GitHub organization (google-gemma), documentation, and a technical report (arXiv). It states that open-weights models are released in both pre-trained and instruction-tuned variants; the pre-trained base model is google/gemma-4-31B. Training data and training code are not stated as released.
quotes: This release includes open-weights models in both pre-trained and instruction-tuned variants.
